items.condition: The submitted calculation uses a different connectivity, charge, multiplicity, tautomer or hydrazone stereoisomer than the public HPY 10a identity.
items.why: Results would not refer to the target molecule.

items.condition: No converged structure or no frequency/minimum evidence is supplied, while numerical observables are presented as the target minimum.
items.why: A saddle point or unconverged geometry cannot support the requested structural conclusion.

items.condition: Dihedral values are reported without four-atom mappings or with mappings that cannot be related to R1/R2/R3 torsions.
items.why: The scored structural observables are not reproducible or identity-bound.

items.condition: The report includes hidden SI targets, claims exact paper-method reproduction without actually documenting the calculation, or treats the reference values as public inputs.
items.why: This invalidates answer isolation and scientific provenance.
